parameters.description:
`pushdeer-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `pushdeer` payload. The gateway composes the upstream PushDeer URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (the `pushkey_secret` parameter names the customer secret holding this enrollment's pushdeer pushkey).
parameters.summary: Relay a push notification through your own PushDeer account by posting a native PushDeer payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

pushkey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's pushdeer pushkey
